# SLD OBD2 — manufacturer data

Manufacturer-specific OBD signal definitions used by the SLD OBD2 Android app's
"Manufacturer extras" screen. Generated by `tools/obdb_import/obdb_import.py`.

**Source:** [OBDb](https://github.com/OBDb) — community documentation for on-board diagnostics.
**Licence:** [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/) (see `LICENSE`, `ATTRIBUTION.md`).
You may reuse this data under the same licence.

## Layout

- `index.json` — every vehicle: `id`, `make`, `model`, `kind` (`model` or make-wide `make`),
  `files` (signal-set files with optional model-year range and signal count), `services` used.
- `vehicles/<id>.json` — `{id, make, model, source, updated, signalsets: {<file>: <OBDb signalset v3>}}`.
  Signal sets are copied unchanged from `signalsets/v3/` of each OBDb repo.
